caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass bowl, positioned centrally on a plain light gray or off-white background. The bowl has a shallow, wide shape with a rounded base that tapers outward to a slightly flared rim. It is illustrated in shades of blue-green, suggesting the glass has a slight turquoise tint. The bowl's surface features a visible lattice or crisscross pattern, which gives texture to its appearance and is highlighted by the use of darker and lighter tones to indicate reflections and transparency. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the drawing, and the composition is minimalistic with the bowl as the sole subject. Near the bowl, on the right side, there is a small handwritten signature or note.
title: Low Glass Dish
